---level31 script---

local isPlayingDemo = false
local countFail = 0
local isSkip = true
local hasViewedStory = global.getBool("lvl31_b1")

if not hasViewedStory or not game.isRestart() then
	repeat
		if hasViewedStory then dialog.setSkipEnabled(true) end
		game.setUserInputEnabled(false)
		role.setIdleActionEnabled(false)
		script.delay(1)
		game.pauseLogic()
		sound.play(55-2)
		if dialog.show("Level31-1", faceZhoumei) ==1 then break end
		camera.setFollowRoleMode(false)
		camera.gotoPosition(447,776)
		if dialog.show("Level31-2", faceBujie) ==1 then break end
		if dialog.show("Level31-3", faceBujie) ==1 then break end
		camera.gotoRole()
		camera.setFollowRoleMode(true)
		
		--set story viewed flag
        global.setBool("lvl31_b1")
		game.resumeLogic()
		
		game.restartTiming()
		game.setUserInputEnabled(true)
		role.setIdleActionEnabled(true)
		isPlayingDemo = false

		isSkip = false
	until true
end

if isSkip then
	camera.gotoRole()
	camera.setFollowRoleMode(true)
	dialog.setSkipEnabled(false)
	game.resumeLogic()
	game.showTutorialDiagram(0)
	game.setUserInputEnabled(true)
	role.setIdleActionEnabled(true)
	game.restartTiming()
end
